# The State of U.S. Tariffs

August 11, 2026

| Updated: August 11, 2026

## Key Takeaways [...] 1. The average statutory tariff rate now stands at 11.0%, roughly where it settled after Section 122 tariffs expired on July 24th and were replaced with new tariffs under Section 301. Under current law, which includes several scheduled tariff increases between now and December, this figure is set to be 11.8% by the end of this year.
2. We estimate the ultimate consumer price impact of current-law tariff policy to be about 0.7%.
